player: (This kid is wearing such a huge jacket…)
(Is it even that cold outside today?)
(... I thought it was summer. What season was it again?)

kid: I have to go home before it gets dark.
My mom always told me it’s dangerous
when you can’t see the sidewalk.
And I didn’t bring any water
Cuz I thought I’d only walk for a little bit.
I only have… 3 dollars and a quarter.

pre_order.player: Don’t worry about that. On the house.

kid: Oh, I… Don’t know if I can drink that.
Sorry. I’m in a hurry, so…!

dialog.kid: Thanks! I have to go now!
